messages:
customer_alex: Our production endpoint (quant-4bit, calibrated last night) is showing 2-3x higher p95 vs the fp16 sibling. Seen across ~20% of requests. Not traffic skewed. Can someone triage?
maria.g: Sorry you're hitting this, Alex. Can you paste a short repro (model+route+example prompt) and the perf numbers you see?
customer_alex: route: /v1/generate?model=redwood-4bit-calib-v2, backend=dedicated-eu. Example prompt: \"Summarize the doc...\". p95: 380ms (fp16 was 120ms). p50 about same. Means tail only.
jonathan: That pattern hints at batching or KV-cache slow path. p50 same, p95 up -> occasional long kernels or fallback path. @maria.g can you capture a short profile from the instance (3 min) and upload scheduler + kernel selection logs?
maria.g: collecting now. Running quick perf profile on the instance: 
```
# capture
run_profiler --pid 11203 --duration 180 --out /tmp/quant-prof.nv
```
Uploading trace...
ashley: FYI saw similar after a calibration tweak where per-layer scales caused extra dequant ops on small batches. Might be hitting a slower 4-bit decode kernel for cached kv rows.
kevin: Received trace and scheduler logs. Initial grep shows many calls to kernel `quant_dequant_pack_v2` and fallback `int8_to_fp32_slowpath` interleaved. Sampled times (ns):
```
quant_dequant_pack_v2  1200  0.3%
attn_kernel_fp16        42000 10.5%
attn_kernel_4bit_slow  230000 57.2%  <-- stands out on p95 traces
kv_cache_read_fast      8000  2.0%
kv_cache_promote_async  15000 4.6%
```
jonathan: That matches: the serving runtime is sometimes choosing the slow 4-bit attention kernel for certain sequence lengths + kv-cache shapes. Likely due to inaccurate per-layer calibration stats causing quant ranges that break fast path.
maria.g: Repro notes: when we replay traffic in staging with same tokens and concurrency=8, we reproduce p95 spike. With concurrency=32 it evens out (more batching -> fast path).
customer_alex: So smaller bursts are worse, ops pattern is chat-like, small tokens. Any mitigation short-term?
ashley: Short-term options: 1) Roll back to fp16 model build (config change) 2) Force kernel selection to prefer fp16 for this model route 3) Tweak batching threshold (lower min_batch_tokens) so runtime aggregates more requests at cost of latency.
kevin: Patch I tested locally: add a kernel hint switch in model config: `prefer_fp16_on_small_kv: true`. With that, staging p95 dropped to ~140ms. Patch diff:
```
- kernel_selector->prefer_fp16 = false;
+ kernel_selector->prefer_fp16 = model_cfg.get_bool("prefer_fp16_on_small_kv", false);
```
maria.g: We should also fix calibration so per-layer scales don't push values into the slowpath. Short term, schedule a re-calibration with per-head clipping relaxed and run quant-aware eval sets focusing on chat workloads.
jonathan: Action items:
- @kevin open a bug with traces + sample tokens (INC-7892).
- @maria.g run re-calib job with relaxed clipping and post results (ETA 4h).
- @ashley prepare rollback plan to fp16 toggle for the customer's route (ETA 1h).
- Communicate to customer: transient mitigation = switch route to fp16 or enable kernel hint.
kevin: Bug created INC-7892 with attached nvprof + scheduler.log. Assigning to eng-runtime/quant.
sre-bot: Deployment note: can deploy kernel-hint toggle without model rebuild; flag is per-route, rolling restart not required. Use `redwoodctl routes update --route id --set prefer_fp16_on_small_kv=true`
maria.g: Re-calibration finished (quick run). Preliminary numbers: per-layer scale adjustments removed the 4-bit slow kernel occurrences in the trace. New staging p95=130ms. Full calib + eval running now (expected 2h).
customer_alex: Thanks team. We'll toggle to fp16 for now and await your update. Please keep us posted and we need an ETA for a permanent fix.
jonathan: Permanent fix path: improve calibration to produce stable ranges for chat-like small-batch workloads + add a fast 4-bit attention kernel fallback that handles these ranges. Timeline: patch + tests ~2 weeks. We'll prioritize because this is a customer blocker.
maria.g: I'll post final calibration artifacts and the eval diffs to the bug when done. Closing loop with Alex after we validate quality. :thumbsup:
